failure_modes.name: Query_Stagnation
failure_modes.evidence: Hop 2 coordinator query: 'What is Vincenzo Bellini's nationality? Was Vincenzo Bellini Italian? What country was Vincenzo Bellini from? Provide biographical information about Vincenzo Bellini including his place of birth and nationality.' Hop 3 coordinator query: 'What was Vincenzo Bellini's nationality or country of origin?' Both queries ask the same question about Bellini's nationality with near-identical wording. Hop 2 already retrieved passages explicitly stating Bellini was Italian (passage [2]: 'was an Italian opera composer'), yet hop 3 re-asks the identical question without advancing to new information needs.
